name: leotiger/lingua-forge-dev
description: Dev tooling for the Lingua Forge WordPress plugin. The plugin source lives in the parent ../  directory and ships with zero runtime Composer dependencies — this dev/ folder holds vendor/, and every linter/test config. Nothing here ever reaches WordPress.org.

scripts.test: WP_TESTS_DIR='' WP_PHPUNIT__DIR='' php -d pcov.enabled=1 -d pcov.directory=.. vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.test:unit: WP_TESTS_DIR='' WP_PHPUNIT__DIR='' php -d pcov.enabled=1 -d pcov.directory=.. vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite=unit
test:integration: ./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'wp plugin activate lingua-forge'

./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'wp eval "\LinguaForge\AI\Core\CacheStore::ensure_table(); \LinguaForge\AI\Core\Glossary::ensure_table(); \LinguaForge\AI\Core\TranslationMemory::ensure_table(); \LinguaForge\AI\Core\UsageRecorder::ensure_table(); echo \"Plugin tables ready.\n\";"'

./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'cd /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/lingua-forge/dev && php -d memory_limit=512M vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml.dist --testsuite=integration --no-coverage'
test:integration:wc: ./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'wp plugin activate lingua-forge woocommerce'

./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'wp eval "\LinguaForge\AI\Core\CacheStore::ensure_table(); \LinguaForge\AI\Core\Glossary::ensure_table(); \LinguaForge\AI\Core\TranslationMemory::ensure_table(); \LinguaForge\AI\Core\UsageRecorder::ensure_table(); echo \"Plugin tables ready.\n\";"'

./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'cd /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/lingua-forge/dev && php -d memory_limit=512M vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml.dist --testsuite=integration:wc --no-coverage'
test:wc-latest: ./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'wp plugin activate woocommerce && echo "=== WC VERSION MATRIX RUN ===" && wp plugin get woocommerce --field=version'
coverage:run: WP_TESTS_DIR='' WP_PHPUNIT__DIR='' php -d pcov.enabled=1 -d pcov.directory=.. vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite=unit --coverage-clover coverage/unit/clover.xml --coverage-html coverage/unit/html --coverage-text=coverage/unit/coverage.txt
./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'wp plugin activate lingua-forge woocommerce'

./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'wp eval "\LinguaForge\AI\Core\CacheStore::ensure_table(); \LinguaForge\AI\Core\Glossary::ensure_table(); \LinguaForge\AI\Core\TranslationMemory::ensure_table(); \LinguaForge\AI\Core\UsageRecorder::ensure_table(); echo \"Plugin tables ready.\n\";"'

./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'mkdir -p /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/lingua-forge/dev/coverage/integration/html && cd /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/lingua-forge/dev && php -d memory_limit=512M -d pcov.enabled=1 -d pcov.directory=/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/lingua-forge vendor/bin/phpunit --configuration phpunit.xml.dist --testsuite=integration --coverage-clover coverage/integration/clover.xml --coverage-html coverage/integration/html --coverage-text=coverage/integration/coverage.txt'
plugin-check: ./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run cli wp plugin install plugin-check --activate || true
./node_modules/.bin/wp-env run cli wp plugin check lingua-forge --exclude-directories=dev,tests --ignore-codes=plugin_updater_detected,update_modification_detected

scripts-descriptions.lint: Run PHPCS against ../ using WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix the subset of PHPCS issues phpcbf can fix.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan with the WordPress stub set against ../.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the full PHPUnit suite (unit + integration).
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run only the unit suite (no WordPress required).
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the full integration suite (requires wp-env running). WC tests self-skip when WooCommerce is absent.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration:wc: Run only the WooCommerce integration suite. Requires .wp-env.override.json with WooCommerce in its plugins list and npm run env:start. Activates WooCommerce in the test env automatically before running.
scripts-descriptions.coverage:setup: Install pcov in the wp-env tests-cli container. Run once after npm run env:start; repeat after env:stop/env:start.
scripts-descriptions.coverage:run: Run unit + integration suites with Clover coverage output. Requires wp-env running + pcov installed (composer coverage:setup).
scripts-descriptions.coverage:merge: Merge unit and integration Clover XMLs into coverage/combined/. Run after coverage:run.
scripts-descriptions.coverage: Full coverage pipeline: coverage:run → coverage:merge. Reports land in coverage/unit/, coverage/integration/, coverage/combined/.
scripts-descriptions.plugin-check: Run the official WordPress Plugin Check tool inside wp-env.
scripts-descriptions.qa: Local pre-deploy gate: coverage:setup → lint (PHPCS) → analyse (PHPStan) → unit tests → lint:js (ESLint) → lint:css (Stylelint). Integration tests require wp-env and must be run separately with composer test:integration.
scripts-descriptions.make-pot: Extract source strings (make-pot), merge into .po files (msgmerge), then clear fuzzy matches (blank msgstr + drop the fuzzy flag) so every string starts clean. Translate the new/blank strings, then run compile-pos.
scripts-descriptions.compile-pos: Compile translated .po files into .mo binaries and .l10n.php caches (steps 4–5 of the i18n pipeline).
scripts-descriptions.translate-missing: On-demand (not per-version): AI-translate every empty string across all 26 locales in one pass. Supports Anthropic (default), OpenAI, or Gemini via --provider=; if omitted at an interactive terminal, asks which provider first (Enter for Anthropic). Requires that provider's API key as an env var (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY) or prompts interactively if unset. Saves after every batch (not just per locale), so an interrupted run resumes with a simple re-run; pass --time-budget=SECONDS to stop cleanly under a wrapper's own process timeout. Writes directly to .po; see dev/translate-missing.log. Flags: --dry-run, --locale=xx, --limit=N, --batch-size=N, --provider=NAME, --model=NAME, --time-budget=SECONDS.
scripts-descriptions.build-zip: Package the plugin into a distributable zip (rsync + .distignore) at ~/Github/lingua-forge-deploy/. Also clears, then rewrites, docs/lf-update-manifest.php's $sha256 field to match the built zip.
